attempt_history.llm_sketch:
workflow_id: currency_conversion_logging
steps:
  - id: call_conversion_api
    op: api_call
    params:
      service: currency_conversion
      method: POST
      body:
        source_amount: "{{ trigger.source_amount }}"
        source_currency: "{{ trigger.source_currency }}"
        target_currency: "{{ trigger.target_currency }}"
    output: conversion_response

  - id: extract_converted_amount
    op: transform
    params:
      source: "{{ conversion_response }}"
      expression: "conversion_response.body.converted_amount"
    output: converted_amount

  - id: log_conversion_result
    op: log
    params:
      level: info
      destination: audit_log
      message: "Currency conversion completed"
      details:
        source_amount: "{{ trigger.source_amount }}"
        source_currency: "{{ trigger.source_currency }}"
        target_currency: "{{ trigger.target_currency }}"
        converted_amount: "{{ converted_amount }}"
        timestamp: "{{ now() }}"
        request_id: "{{ trigger.request_id }}"
